data.normalization_policy: recompute from train only and exactly match saved stats
data.validation_status: previously inspected development diagnostic, not pristine holdout

baselines.persistence: last observed visual latent repeated for each future horizon; normalized current-relative state residual zero
baselines.common_support: original target validity AND latest history observation validity; never backfill older observation
baselines.reference_reuse_gate: all original masks, input and target tensor hashes, metadata, split and normalization must match reference trace elementwise; otherwise stop comparison
baselines.random_comparison_claim: untrained current-latent-plus-random-residual versus persistence, not learned dynamics or action usefulness

model.trainable_scope_if_later_authorized: only existing native world model; extractor not loaded or updated

objective.aggregation: separate branch valid scalar sums/counts, not batch-mean averaging

required_before_execution: separate explicit user authorization for this diagnostic scope
implemented gradient, optimizer and checkpoint guards
verified pinned inputs and initial parameter hash
short runtime estimate or user-run command
future_learning_diagnostic.sampling_rng: separate torch.Generator(device='cpu'); never shared with model initialization, logging or evaluation
future_learning_diagnostic.sampling_algorithm: torch.randint(134, (200,16), generator=generator); existing train dataset window order; with replacement
future_learning_diagnostic.checkpoint_selection: final update200 only; no best-val checkpoint, early stopping or hyperparameter search
future_learning_diagnostic.failure_policy: nonfinite loss/gradients, missing gradients or provenance mismatch fail closed; no skipped batches or extra steps
future_learning_diagnostic.recovery_policy: initial version has no partial resume; preserve failed output, never start concurrent copy, explicit justified fresh attempt only
completion_evidence: finite nonzero gradients without extractor gradients
saved final checkpoint and reload prediction equivalence
frozen files, split, normalization and sampler hash unchanged
future_learning_diagnostic.efficiency_reporting: separate training and evaluation wall time, device/software and completed steps; no cross-model speed claim from this pilot

evaluation.absolute_change: candidate minus named reference; lower error is better
evaluation.relative_change: 100 * (candidate-reference) / reference; null when reference is zero or either value unsupported
evaluation.coverage: report original and common valid scalar counts; do not compare mismatched supports
evaluation.statistical_unit: episode, not overlapping window; current one episode per partition is descriptive only
evaluation.uncertainty: no across-seed uncertainty from a single seed; no confidence intervals treating windows as independent
evaluation.decision: report every branch and fixed checkpoint; success/failure is limited to engineering and short-horizon development diagnostics, never generalization

future_quality_study.source_selection: public metadata-only deterministic selection before outcomes; no project simulation/current-real data silently adapted
future_quality_study.split: known-task within-task whole-episode holdout; audit source duplicates and group any verified trajectory families
future_quality_study.task_holdout: not supported as language generalization by current closed-set embedding; requires separate representation decision
future_quality_study.seeds: freeze repeated seeds and equal optimizer budgets before any quality runs; do not infer from one seed
future_quality_study.robustness: separate frozen clean/degraded paired protocol, identical tasks/splits/checkpoints; no quality claim from current clean feature pair

ablation_requirements_before_claims.action_conditioning: matched-budget action-ablated prediction comparison and appropriate action-dependency evidence
ablation_requirements_before_claims.low_visibility_consistency: not implemented; requires separately authorized method and paired clean/degraded study
ablation_requirements_before_claims.candidate_ranking: K1 observed actions cannot evaluate counterfactual ranking or causal effects
